guides.favoredWhen: Bad matchup for her. She starts shield and holds E2 through dashes. Dash freely, angle linears.

keyTips.text: Bad matchup for her: her Doran's plus Second Wind only delays.
If her E lands she holds E2 to track through invis and R dashes: break it.
Her engages are straight lines: your linears hit her on the way in, so hold them.

tips.text: She survives the early: shield start concedes the lane, so zone her.
She lands E before committing: no mark means no follow, so dodge the mark.
She tracks through every dash: held E2 is her only stick, so multi-dash.
She avoids straight lines: cover angles with linears.
Shook plus zoned: the Akali who never stuck to you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She dodges Q and E at CS time and punishes cooldowns. Vary poke, match shove, win skirmishes.

keyTips.text: She dodges your Q and E poke, especially walking to CS: lead her.
She steps in only when Q or E is down: stagger cooldowns.
Whoever lands first wins: match her range and strike first.

tips.text: She does not force trades in levels 1-5: your poke wins them, so press.
She wins trades by dodging at CS time: hold Q until she commits.
The lane turns into a waveclear contest: shove and skirmish better.
She matches your shove and never hands free control: out-shove her.
She wins the skirmish game around shoves, not the 1v1: pick the 1v1.

sources.author: AuroraAddict
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims Grandmaster and Rank 1 Aurora EUNE) · Aurora main

guides.favoredWhen: The 1v1 favors her, but your level 6 gank setup does not. Concede range, convert setup.

keyTips.text: The 1v1 favors her: never take the duel when offered.
She builds an early lead by outranging you: range is her edge, so close.
Your gank setup at 6 is dangerous: call it on schedule.

tips.text: She outranges from level 1: every max-range Q is free for her, so dodge.
She banks the lead before 6: the setup lands on schedule, so survive to it.
She wards at 6: sweep before the setup.
Your 6-setup is the threat, not your damage: coordinate it.
Setup converted plus 6 landed: the Syndra whose lead never banked loses.

keyTips.text: Bully early and contest mid 2v2s whenever the jungler can follow.
Treat roughly 13 to 17 minutes as the strongest phase and keep pressing priority, tracking, and roams.
Hunt backline angles with mobility and burst, but never pair Flash and R on a low-value target.

tips.text: Stand ready to help the jungler invade, contest the river, or gank mid, checking first whether Aurora can push first.
Turn waveclear into priority, since enemies who chase a roam without it donate the wave for a worse play.
Spend priority on a roam, a jungle invade, or safer vision rather than idling in lane.
Trigger Electrocute fast with Q. Run Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, and Ultimate Hunter plus Manaflow Band and Transcendence.
Start Doran's Ring with two Health Potions, then recall for Dark Seal, Refillable Potion, and Boots when affordable.
Push side waves to force a response, then roam, invade, or slide toward an objective with the free time.
When enemies collapse, burn escape tools to waste their time only if the team converts elsewhere during the distraction.
Control vision and lane priority late, then punish mispositioning with picks and objective pressure.
Link early priority with the jungler, then turn picks into vision and objective control.
Reach squishy backline targets from a safe angle in mid and late fights.
While ahead, shove sides and force opponents to choose between answering Aurora and contesting the team objective.

itemization.text: Run Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, and Ultimate Hunter with Manaflow Band and Transcendence; Ultimate Hunter keeps the teamfight ultimate up more often.
Swap Celerity in when movement speed matters, especially top lane, pairing it with Boots of Swiftness.
Try Presence of Mind plus Alacrity only for skirmish-heavy games, since the setup can run short on mana.
Take Flash and Teleport standard, Barrier into high-burst assassins, and Cleanse into Zoe bubble.
Build Stormsurge into Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, and Zhonya's Hourglass.
Treat the Hextech Gunblade build as the alternate, and the anti-assassin setup as the explicitly weaker option.
